name: Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO (MIUI, HyperOS)
note: MIUI and HyperOS show ads inside the file manager, the themes app, the security scan and the installer itself. Several entries here are specifically the ad frameworks (MSA, Analytics) rather than apps you ever see.

packages.label: MSA (ad framework, global)
packages.note: The system ad service. This is the one that puts ads in Settings and the file manager.

packages.label: GetApps / Mi Picks
packages.note: Xiaomi's app store, and a notification-ad source.

packages.label: Cleaner
packages.note: Part of Security. Shows ads while 'cleaning'.

packages.label: MIUI Daemon
packages.note: Also carries some hardware logging; a few builds get noisy logcat afterwards.

packages.label: Weather
packages.note: Carries ads in the forecast. The lock-screen weather widget goes blank.

packages.label: Notes
packages.note: Export anything you keep in it first; disabling hides existing notes.

packages.label: App Vault
packages.note: The sponsored-cards page left of the home screen.

packages.label: Mi Account
packages.note: Find Device and cloud backup stop. Keep it if the phone might get lost.

packages.label: Mi Cloud
packages.note: Cloud photo and contact sync stops. Anything already uploaded stays on Xiaomi's servers; anything only on the phone stops being backed up.

packages.label: Mi Cloud Sync
packages.note: The sync adapter behind Mi Cloud. Contacts and notes stop syncing, which people notice only after a reset.

packages.label: Quick Apps
packages.note: Xiaomi's mini-app runtime. A common source of surprise notifications.

packages.label: Security
packages.note: MIUI hangs permissions, autostart and app lock off this. Disabling it breaks Settings pages.

packages.label: MIUI Home (launcher)
packages.note: Install another launcher and set it as Home first.

packages.label: Security Add-on
packages.note: An extension of MIUI's Security app. Some builds route second-space and app-lock settings through it, so a Settings page can go blank.

packages.label: Joyose
packages.note: Sends game and usage data to Xiaomi; also does per-game throttling.
